test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.

The DNA stands were separated through ______ methods.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'electrophoresis'**.
 
• **Electrophoresis** is a process used to separate DNA strands based on their size and charge using an electric field.
 
• This technique is widely used in molecular biology for analyzing DNA, RNA, and proteins.

Correct sentence: *The DNA strands were separated through **electrophoresis** methods.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electrophoresis:**
 
 
• **Principle:** Molecules are separated based on their charge and size when placed in an electric field.
 
• **Example:** Agarose gel electrophoresis is commonly used for DNA separation.
 
• **Applications:** Used in genetic research, forensic science, and biotechnology.
 
 
 
• **Incorrect Options:**
 
 
• **Option 1:** 'Electroforesis' - Incorrect spelling.
 
• **Option 3:** 'Electrophorresis' - Incorrect spelling with an extra 'r'.
 
• **Option 4:** 'Electrophoreses' - Incorrect plural form.
